$description: HEREweHOLO design tokens — single source of truth for Figma variables, Tailwind config and mockups. Products: HoloMe (sender app), HoloSee (receiver), HEREweHOLO Cloud (dashboard). Two themes: dark (default) and light. HoloSee is dark-only — the hologram needs a black background.

themes.light: Full mode for HoloMe and Cloud. Never applied to HoloSee.

bg.description: App ground (dark: gunmetal ink-0; light: paper-0)

cyan.description: Primary accent — text/icons darken in light for contrast

error.description: Magenta per brand — not pure red

fixed.$description: Theme-independent. Vivid fills (gradient button, LIVE dot), dark glass overlays on the camera, and everything on HoloSee.

gradientBeam.description: Reserved for the primary action and brand moments. Identical in both themes; dark text #06131A on top.

glass.description: Overlay chips on the camera preview — always dark, in both themes

cameraCyc.description: Camera preview ground (white cyclorama reference) — same in both themes

display.usage: Wordmark, screen titles, GO LIVE, large numerals. Uppercase + tracking for labels.

ui.usage: All running UI text, buttons, body copy.

mono.usage: Status strip, telemetry, resolutions, codes. Always tabular.

motion.principle: No decorative animation. Every transition explains a state change. Theme switches are instant — no crossfade.
motion.reducedMotion: All loops (live pulse, connecting rings, ambient glow) freeze to their strongest static frame under prefers-reduced-motion.

voice.note: Applied to the outgoing audio path before encode; the receiver hears the effect, never the raw voice. Deliberate own addition — the reference labels its carousel 'Voice Changer' while showing AR lenses.

statusStrip.format: HH:MM:SS · STATE · W × H · FF fps · BB.B Mbps
statusStrip.rule: Six live values, one line, monospace, never faked. 0 × 0 and STANDBY are legitimate values; a resolution is only shown when the full chain has verified it.
